title: Implementation and Evaluation of NTT Arithmetic for ML-KEM on a CGLA
summary: FIPS 203 standardizes ML-KEM for post-quantum key establishment. Its polynomial multiplication relies on NTT butterflies with exact modular arithmetic over q = 3329. Dedicated NTT accelerators minimize latency with fixed modular arithmetic and stage schedules. A CPU-Grounded Linear Array (CGLA) reuses one programmable linear datapath across several workloads. Mapping the transform to this datapath requires exact FP32 reconstruction and explicit stage transitions across the ARM-to-CGLA interface.
